name: Sociedade Esportiva Palmeiras
notes: Accounts are calendar-year 2025 (R$ thousands); the integrated report's statements match the separately posted 'Balanço e DRE 2025'. Revenue is 'receita operacional líquida' R$1.628bn, which includes player sales and prize money (financial income of R$154.573m is reported separately, below the operating result). Valuation corrected from an earlier record (4.3bn) to Sports Value's R$4.395bn as printed by CNN Brasil. No ownership transactions or major financings since 2015 were found; Palmeiras is a member of the Libra bloc (the Mubadala Capital exclusivity was not found as a closed league-stake sale). The stadium's operator Real Arenas (WTorre) holds the 30-year surface right; the 2026 change of naming rights from Allianz to Nubank was not documented on a citable page beyond the club site's use of the name, and any change in Real Arenas' own shareholders was not checked (web search budget exhausted). Honours: the club's titles gallery lists 12 Campeonato Brasileiro years (incl. 1967 Taça Brasil) but states no count, so honours is null. No dated social follower counts or exact average attendance found. The club site shows 168,568 Avanti members (undated live counter), not recorded. Betting sponsors: a provisional measure announced 25 Sep 2026 bans betting operators and their advertising in Brazil from 6 Oct 2026 (MKT Esportivo, 2 Oct 2026), which affects the Sportingbet shirt deal.

ownership_summary: Sociedade Esportiva Palmeiras is a not-for-profit civil association owned by its members; it has no SAF and no outside shareholder. Leila Pereira has been president since December 2021 and was re-elected on 24 November 2024 for a second term.
